selected_deep_read_xsd_comparison_family.service_change_in_integration_commit: Enumerations include changed from V2.2 to V2.4
selected_deep_read_xsd_comparison_family.rule: Use this complete family for technical PDF/XSD comparison only as candidate/integration authority. Do not describe success as official V2.4 release XSD conformance.

TVS_V2.4.fresh_read_rule: Do not open historical TVS V2.4 findings, including TVS-001, until the independent V2.4 PDF fresh read and targeted visible review are frozen.

visual_evidence.rule: Targeted visible review supports observations but does not justify exhaustive_read.

fresh_observations_before_historical_rec: The V2.4 foreword explicitly says the new short-haul operation requires new XSD 2.4.
German operation overview still uses Get/Subscribe/UnsubscribeCurrentStopPoint while also adding GetCurrentShortHaulStops.
English operation overview repeats the stale CurrentStopPoint-era names and adds GetCurrentShortHaulStops.
German and English functional-sequence prose still says SubscribeCurrentStop.
Chapter 3 states that the corresponding XSD is master if description and XSD differ.
Chapter 3.1 is GetCurrentTariffStop, but response/table labels still say GetCurrentStopPointResponse and CurrentStopPointData while the body uses CurrentTariffStop names.
CurrentTripRef is visibly printed as IBIS-IP.NMToken in both CurrentTariffStopData and the new CurrentShortHaulStopsData.
GetCurrentLine response display again concatenates TicketValidationServiceCurrentLineData without the service-name separator dot.
VehicleData.RouteDeviation is visibly printed with RouteDirectionEnumeration.
The new GetCurrentShortHaulStops section visibly defines its response, CurrentShortHaulStopsData, CurrentTariffStop 0:* and CurrentTripRef 0:1.
V2.4 version history documents introduction of GetCurrentShortHaulStops and retains the prior V2.2 rename and V2.3 correction statements.
The list of tables still carries GetCurrentStopPointResponse and CurrentStopPointData names.
Visible -1:1 rows are VDV choice notation and are not cardinality findings.
fresh_read_disproof_notes: The new GetCurrentShortHaulStops operation is not itself treated as a defect; the official PDF explicitly introduces it.
No conclusion about TVS-001 or any historical V2.4 finding was used during the fresh read.
Upstream-master and candidate/integration XSD provenance remain separate; no successful candidate-family validation may be labeled official V2.4 release conformance.
TVS_V2.4.fresh_read_freeze_rule: Historical V2.4 findings may be opened only after this independent snapshot commit is permanent.
